semiconductor_relevance: High — HEIDENHAIN specializes in measurement and control technologies that are critical for precision in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HEIDENHAIN Co., Ltd provides advanced measurement, control, and drive system technologies essential for the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance the accuracy and efficiency of automated systems and machines used in semiconductor fabrication and assembly.

regional_presence.Taiwan: HEIDENHAIN has a dedicated presence in Taiwan, focusing on semiconductor and electronics industries.
